title: Laredo College Position 9 heads to December runoff: Vela, Lopez advance
excerpt: Dr. Alicia Vela and Carlos Lopez Jr. will meet in a December 12 runoff for Position 9 on the Laredo College Board of Trustees after neither cleared 50% on November 3.
content:
The race for Position 9 on the Laredo College Board of Trustees is headed to a runoff.

Dr. Alicia Vela and Carlos Lopez Jr. finished as the top two vote-getters in the November 3 election, but neither reached the 50% threshold needed to win outright, according to KGNS. Unofficial results put Vela at about 42% and Lopez at about 34%.

The runoff is set for Saturday, December 12, 2026, with early voting running November 30 through December 5.

Vela is an assistant professor of history at Laredo College, director of the college's Honors Program, and an alumna of the college. She declined to comment, according to KGNS.

Lopez is a longtime Laredo resident and former City of Laredo employee. He told KGNS he wants to focus on transparency, saying: “I want to focus on transparency, because I believe the community deserves to know how the money is spent, and I believe that's the key to trust.”

Laredo College President Minita Ramirez said the runoff will cost the college between $88,000 and $90,000, according to KGNS.

Sources: KGNS, reporting on the Laredo College Position 9 runoff on November 4, 2026.
